synopsis.text: The dynamic new creative team of Brubaker and Epting keeps the intensity high! Pursuing the Red Skull's mysterious trail brings Cap and S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Sharon Carter into a brutal crossfire between warring factions of A.I.M. What does one of these groups have to do with the Skull's evil plans? And, is it just their imagination, or are Sharon and Cap being followed?

More flashback WWII stuff. We see the present day Union Jack, and some all out action! Jack Monroe (Nomad) appears, and is looking down on his luck. He later gets shot and is stuffed in the trunk of a car by an unknown assailant. He is apparently dead.
